chapter: Uncle Gaiye and New Orleans bands
title: Playing guitar and bass with Chris Kelly's band
summary: Nelson recalls playing in Chris Kelly's band, where Johnny St. Cyr and Kid Rena were also heard; he names bassist Cleo and says he played guitar, banjo and some bass.
